CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation present linking to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red/blue coordinate sets) and its organization (full-grid listings) plus a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement linked to the identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate listings identify content (red/blue) and attribute (color) at named referents and current time.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata fields are provided separately from the coordinate content listings, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit listings show how content is organized/presented (full-grid occupancy) for a named current referent.
